reason: A more directly addresses the required reduction in platinum-group-metal loading through a substantive, testable support-plus-dispersion strategy, whereas B merely reproduces an already reported comparison between two PGM-free spinels without benchmarking displacement of a conventional PGM catalyst. A is weakened by extrapolating the cited bare-spinel activity gain to PGM-supported catalysts and should use loading-matched controls, but it remains the better proposal.
